subject: Intel's AI Pipeline
text:
[NAME], 

There's a pattern we keep seeing with ML teams at your stage: engineers burning sprint cycles on a pipeline stage that isn't the actual constraint. 

Labeling is usually the first thing to get attention; it's measurable, the team can point to output, and it's easy to staff up. But when we map the pipeline, the real throughput bottleneck is in curation or validation far more often than anyone expects. Model performance doesn't move. Nobody can explain why. 

We built a diagnostic that identifies which stage it actually is for your setup; maps across curation, labeling, QA, and validation, and generates a fix-priority report. 

If that's useful, I'll send it over.

subject: Dinner w/ Data & Physical AI folks in Boston on 03/26
text:
Hi [NAME], hope you're well.

Our Director of Product will be visiting customers in Boston on 26 March
and hosting a small dinner that evening in Seaport. We're looking to
connect and collaborate with Physical AI leaders across the
Cambridge/Boston ecosystem and would love to have you join.

training data collection, automated & manual labelling and active learning
loops. Given your industry experience and work at RAI, I thought this would
have strong overlaps.

Would love to connect either at dinner or, if easier, over a coffee on
26/27th?

Let me know if you're available and I can have our Events Lead share more

filtering processes repeatable without a new Jupyter notebook each time.

feedback on our approach. Would you be open to connecting with him for 30
min?

text:
Hi [NAME],

Noticed Dzyne will be at WACV and guessed you may be in Arizona as well.

I met [SENDER] at WEST, and wanted to invite you to an AI leaders dinner
our co-founders, [SENDER] and [SENDER], are hosting on 8 March alongside the
conference for ~20 senior leaders in computer vision and AI - we'd love it
if you could join.

If Encord is new to you, we're a multimodal ML DataOps platform that helps
AI and computer vision teams produce better quality data for their models -

their autonomous systems.

We've booked a private dining room at BATA, just a short walk from the
venue, from 6pm onwards - you'll be joined by execs, co-founders and Heads
of AI in the Encord network from Woven by Toyota, Boston Dynamics and more.

Would you be interested in joining? If so, I'll send over the full details.
